Move 25% faster while drawing or holding a bow.
Steady Aim

Opening Strike

puffish_skills.aeroscapes_reimagine.rang: Light Armor Handling
Use the full protection and effects of ordinary light armor, including chainmail. Each trained piece adds 1% movement speed.
puffish_skills.aeroscapes_reimagine.comb: Use the full protection and effects of heavy armor. Each trained piece slows movement by 1%, down from 6%.
puffish_skills.aeroscapes_reimagine.rang: Windward Armor
Wear the Windward set to move faster while drawing and take less projectile damage. The full set adds 22% arrow damage against targets at least 8 blocks away.
Duskstride Armor

Wear the Duskstride set to sprint and sneak faster and soften melee and fall damage. With the full set, a charged light-weapon hit that deals damage grants 28% movement speed for 3 seconds. 6-second cooldown.
